about: Standard VAT / GST on a machine bought by a manufacturer — read on PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Corporate > Other taxes (fetched 2 Nov 2026). A manufacturer recovers it, so a price quoted VAT-inclusive is divided by (1 + rate) before it is a capex.

JP.quote: The general rate is 10%; however, a lower rate of 8% applies to food and beverages

KR.quote: VAT is generally levied at a rate of 10% on the supply of goods and services in Korea.

TW.quote: VAT is applicable to general industries, and the VAT rate is 5%.

TH.quote: The standard rate of VAT is 10%, but the rate is currently reduced to 7% until 30 September 2027

MY.quote: Sales tax ... The ad valorem rates are 5% or 10% depending on the class of goods. ... machinery ... generally non-dutiable or subject to duties at lower rates
MY.note: Malaysia has a single-stage sales tax, not VAT; manufacturing machinery is commonly exempt — a Malaysian price quoted with SST is treated case by case, never by a blanket rate

SG.quote: GST is charged at 9% on the supply of goods and services made in Singapore

VN.quote: The VAT rates are 0%, 5%, 10%, and exempt, depending on the category of goods ... Import VAT typically ranges from 5% to 10% (maybe reduced to 8%)
VN.note: machinery is at the 10% standard rate; a temporary 8% reduction may apply — a VAT-inclusive price is divided by 1.10 and the note says 8% would give +1.9%

ID.quote: The VAT rate is currently 12%. However, the government has decided to implement the 12% rate by using Other Value as Tax Base ... of 11/12, resulting in an 'effective' VAT rate of 11% for most taxable goods

PH.quote: The tax is equivalent to a uniform rate of 12%
